rules: Grayscale interface and text selection; theme swatches retain palette colors.
Supplied English and corresponding Chinese vocabulary use yellow fill and bold black text; annotations are red.
Forest theme uses a green circular swatch.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Account/export popovers and modal cards; CSS --shadow.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Control color/border transitions and press feedback.

motion.name: definition-focus
motion.purpose: Selected definition-word background fades to transparent.

motion.name: completion-appear
motion.purpose: Fade in a suggested word suffix after the typing pause; reduced motion shows it immediately.

contextTranslation.scope: The actual English example sentence containing the selected vocabulary and its single-sentence Chinese translation.
contextTranslation.savedTranslation: Reuse a valid saved paragraph translation only when the paragraph contains one English sentence.
contextTranslation.request: Authenticated POST /api/context/translation, loaded lazily for the selected definition; paragraph, paragraphTranslation and terms provide context.

sessionCache.requestDeduplication: An in-flight request map shares requests for the same payload and clears each entry on completion.
sessionCache.eviction: Remove the oldest inserted result when the cache exceeds 200 translations.

contextTranslation.status: A role=status region shows loading or unavailable state with a retry button; empty status and translation elements are hidden.
contextTranslation.highlights: Retain English vocabulary and aligned Chinese-term highlights; match overlapping Chinese terms once.

library.dateBasis: first addition (createdAt), displayed in browser local time
library.folders: create, rename, delete retaining articles, and move articles

notebook.disclosure: Separate 44px chevron button inside .study-controls on the mastery row; aria-expanded and aria-controls toggle a hidden details section.
notebook.delete: Visible and accepted only for mastered entries.
notebook.sourceAction: Open the saved source article snapshot and focus its target word; older entries fall back to matching favorites, then local history.
notebook.sourceStorage: sourceArticle JSON persists with local and cloud notebook entries and survives definition hydration.

calendar.sizeBehavior: Standard uses month navigation and 本月; thumbnail shows twelve months with year navigation and 今年. Size selection uses aria-pressed and persists as standard or mini under texta_calendar_size. Selecting an addition date opens its filtered list with return and clear-date controls, and stores the selected month so standard shows that month.
calendar.animationTargets: Standard calendar-grid and thumbnail calendar-year-grid use the shared grid transition; miniature inner grids do not animate separately. Reduced motion disables both grid targets and date markers.

vocabularyComposer.description: The vocabulary composer follows the approved unified-panel mockup: a warm panel with a 20px outer radius, sage vocabulary tags in Texta Serif, import/clear actions in the heading, and a separated bottom settings bar. Tags support editing, removal, phrase-preserving paste, case-insensitive deduplication and spelling feedback. A pending word remains part of the saved draft and generation request. Long lists scroll within two rows or expand. Level and output mode remain visible; quality and quick mode live in More settings with an always-visible credit summary. Mobile places level/settings above the segmented mode and generation action. All six palettes use the existing semantic tokens. Implementation: `public/vocabulary.css` and `public/vocabulary.js`.
vocabularyComposer.typing: Vocabulary typing uses bold text with an aligned paint layer over the native textarea. A matching suffix fades in after a short pause; Tab accepts it only at the end of the input, Escape dismisses it and Shift+Tab retains normal navigation. Reduced motion shows the suffix without animation. Local dictionary lookups mark high-confidence errors on the affected letters, with a red wavy underline, in both the draft and committed tags. No separate spelling message is rendered below the editor. Valid words, incomplete prefixes, proper names and uncertain matches are left unmarked. The source word list and MIT attribution are vendored under `public/vendor/english-words.*`; no external spelling requests are made by the composer.

accountNavigation.description: The login card contains only authentication controls; the product introduction and plan links are removed. Registration disclosures and public policy pages remain accessible from the authentication and pricing pages. The account popover contains identity, usage, administration where authorized, help and theme settings, without the policy/contact links or duplicated plan entry. A single `Plus / Pro 套餐` navigation link is styled as a 44px button immediately beside Account and remains available to all signed-in roles. It uses the incumbent panel, line, primary, soft and radius tokens, with visible keyboard focus. Narrow phones keep the two account actions together on their own row; intermediate widths move study navigation to a second row. English uses `Plus / Pro plans`. Purchasing remains paused at the backend.

responsive.behavior: Compact header gaps and tab padding.
Study navigation wraps onto a second row.
Plans and Account remain together on a full-width row; the language toggle stays next to the wordmark.

narrative.overview: The confirmed direction favors open space, clear study actions and visible links between vocabulary in the article and its selected definition. Interface copy names actions or explains actual state. Chinese is the default interface language with a persistent English switch; learning content keeps its own language.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground with sage action and selection colors.
Display serif for identity and English titles; Georgia for reading.
Broad content areas, quiet dividers and restrained controls.
Functional state changes with short motion and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Study State Rule
rules.body: Use sage to identify an action, selected study state or vocabulary relationship; carry meaning with text and state attributes as well as color.

rules.name: The Language Role Rule
rules.body: Keep display lettering, English reading and Chinese interface text in their assigned stacks. The interface-language toggle does not rewrite the article.

rules.name: The Reading Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep article paragraphs on the page plane. Use tonal containers for study support and ambient elevation for floating controls.
